Name: Pokemon Ranch - Patch Pack
Author: SilverVenthil
Description:
Pkr Patch Pack is a series of tweaks, reworks and bugfixes for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/plaidbees?gameId=1303]plaidbee's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24619]Pokemon Ranch[/url] mod, made with their permission. primarily intended to improve a variety of aspects of the original mod from treasure digging to more varied animal produce outputs as to make specing into pokemon ranching be less intrusive on bundle progression. at its core this series of patches is mainly to give the pokemon a throughline focus of producing more stuff than other animals meaning their more work to get full value out of, with a side of making variants of the same family have differing features.

relying heavily on a new feature in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328?tab=description]Extra Animal Config[/url] 1.8.0 to easily apply weighted randomness to items dug up by animals. the goal of this project is first to make the invididual animal families feel more distinct from eachother, and supply a variety of cross mod interactivity suiting themes and generally make pokemon outputs feel more consistent in what you get happy pokemon resulting in getting fewer eggs didn't sit right with me.

Notably this mod restores the PokeBarn and Coop doors to the same size as normal buildings.

overarching changes ;

TMs : dropped overnight independantly of all other produce, with a 7% base spawn chance on the same interval as Eggs, this spawn chance is them modified by the Daily Luck, causing it to Vary from 0% to 19% chance to spawn with the special charm.

Treasure Boxes : Dug up outside in addition to other produce every 3 days 25% of the time.  starting at 2 1/2 hearts Bow and Candy Treasure Boxes will be dug up with a 25% chance, and finally at 3 1/2 hearts Deluxe treasure boxes begin to spawn. these notably work like truffles meaning multiple treasure boxes can be found on a single day and happier pokemon find more treasure!

Eggs : Pokemon with produce that arent eggs or held items are changed to produce eggs in addition to other produce rather than an either or.

Sell Prices : are set to a minimum of the cost to purchase the animal, more evolved forms featuring higher maximum sell value instead of sell prices being *half* of the buy price as opposed to the half the buy price in the original mod.

Meats : the special Miltank, Lechonk, Wooloo and Farfetch'd meats are disabled in favor of providing standard animal husbandry mod meats in order to streamline play and avoid bloat of visually simmilar but not stacking items. it would be recommended to tune these animals item outputs due to the change in meat value. (likely to be done in a future update)

Pokemon are now permitted to live in regular coops/barns to help streamline farms with multiple buildings, or just the meadowlands. note this does not permit them be bought directly into the regular coop/barn but they can be hatched or moved to one.

Specific Pokemon (Taking Suggestions for mons in the mod not listed here);

Lechonk & Unown - due to getting stuck in the structure doors even with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33514]Squeeze Through[/url] to ensure large animals don't get stuck inside, an issue with the sprites which plaidbees as graciously given me permission to work on but are temporarily disabled for purchase they can still be accessed via commands if you really want.

Combee & Vespiquen - both forms of Combee now dig up seasonal flowers outside during the day, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31672]Cornucopia : More Flowers[/url] starting at two hearts they will be able to dig up flowers from that mod. Vespiquen digs up honey instead of flowers given they are both Hive and Queen. Additionally Combee now gives Bug Meat like Vespiquen when butchered via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url].
Buy price : 1250g

(Alolan)Vulpix/Nintales - now digs up mushrooms outside by default, if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24409]Ars Venifici[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url] are loaded they will instead forage items from those mods. Kantonian Vulpix goes out year round when its sunny, Alolan Vulpix only goes outside when its rainy, stormy, snowing or Sunny in winter but finds more rarer mushrooms
Buy price : 3500

Miltank - now provides small milk every day, small or large milk every 2 days with enough friendship, and Moomoo milk every 3 days. so specing into pokemon ranching doesn't screw with your Animal bundle progress.
Miltank milk is now considered as milk for purposes that can and can be consumed. large miltank milk can now go in the cheese press to produce 2-3 moomoo cheese quality is utilized like the loom does wool. plus a bonus for shepherds.
at 4 times the price of a regular dairy cow it felt important to make miltank feel more special, and i felt that producing dedicatedly small milk would mean using them to supply cooking is actually realtively reasonable, especially when pokemon eggs count for cooking purposes.
Buy price : 4000g

Wooloo - Provides regular sheeps wool every 2 days, and special wooloo wools every 3 days.
Wooloo wools now work the same as regular wool in the loom rather than retaining quality.
Buy price : 6500g


Rowlet/Dartrix/Decidueye - if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url]﻿ is loaded digs up alchemy forage like deer hooves, bird skulls, stag antlers and the new monster parts added by that mod.
Buy Price : 7000g

Charmander/Charmeleon/Charizard - Finds Eggs, Duck Feathers and Rabbits feet while outside. if playing with Animal Husbandy Mod instead digs up eggs and meat items.
Charmander family pokemon go out in sunny weather year round, keep in mind that in Stardew Valley Windy weather and Sunny weather are separate!
Buy price : 7000g

Bulbasaur/Ivysaur/Venusaur - Grows seasonal flowers on Even days and seasonal berries on Odd days, on their backs to be collected with Shears!
smaller flower frogs produce fewer more quickly, bigger ones produce more at a time more slowly, Bulbasaur 1-2 every 3 days, Ivysaur 2-3 every 5 days, Venusaur 4-5 every 9 days.

Eevee - Same as Charmander, but Vaporeon, Jolteon, Glaceon and Leafeon go out in the rain, Flareon, Glaceon and Eevee in the winter. and Umbreon, Espeon and Sylveon find more and rarer treasures more often.

Solrock & Lunatone - intelligent psychic space rocks? sounds like convenient geode finders to me. these guys dig up random geodes based on mines progression, and if Ars Venefici is loaded potenially sun or moon stone respectively.
Buy price - 7500g
